description: Curated registry of Nigerian regulatory agencies, exposure drafts, official gazettes, legal portals, and policy intelligence trackers for daily scanning (Goal 2c)

governance.sign_off_policy: Dual sign-off required: Both a Reva Platform Admin and a Vanta Admin must approve new registry additions or updates.
governance.policy_scope: Both enacted policies and incoming policy instruments: proposed National Assembly bills, regulator exposure drafts, consultative papers, circulars, and executive orders.

scraping_rules.focus: New laws, circulars, exposure drafts, consultative papers, executive orders, regulatory frameworks, tariff adjustments, tax policies, compliance mandates
scraping_rules.opportunity_synthesis: Extract venture opportunities, compliance platforms (RegTech), infrastructure solutions, and market shifts created by each policy
